source: captured on the campaign host on 2026-11-13 before the timed campaign (superproject 820ffc8; /proc/cpuinfo, sysconf, uname, lscpu in host-lscpu.txt); engine commits are the gitlinks pinned by 820ffc8; every engine binary was built from them with rustc 1.100.0

host.cgroup: v1 memory controller; each timed stage alone in its own child group
host.allocation: all 4 vCPUs to each flow; RustEDA 8 GiB cap (+2 GiB memsw), LibreLane 10 GiB cap; no swap device
host.sampling: one timed sample per flow; module stages one warm-up plus three measured repetitions
host.producer_executor: rusteda flow exec (native step-graph executor, superproject apps/ at the same commit)
